name: granola
description: Read and search meeting notes, summaries and transcripts from Granola.
long_description: Use your Granola API key to read and search accessible meeting notes, summaries, transcripts, folders and spaces without storing the key on your Sprite. Requires a Business or Enterprise plan. Saving or testing a key reads at most one note summary; an empty result is valid. Access follows the key’s scopes and workspace controls. Webhooks, audit logs, legal holds and account management are not forwarded.

messages.401: Granola API key is invalid, revoked or expired; replace it in this connection
messages.403: Granola denied access; check the key’s scopes, workspace controls, subscription and IP allowlist
messages.404: Granola note is unavailable or inaccessible; only notes with a generated summary are returned
messages.413: Transcript is too large to include in the note; use GET /v1/notes/NOTE_ID/transcript
messages.429: Granola rate limit reached; retry later

presentation.tagline: Read Granola meeting notes without storing your API key on a Sprite.
presentation.setup: On a Granola Business or Enterprise plan, open Settings → Connectors → API keys in the desktop app. Create a key with the note access scopes you need, then paste it here. Workspace admins can also create a workspace API key.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Requires a Granola Business or Enterprise subscription. Saving or testing a key reads at most one note summary and creates no meeting or AI summary. Requests count against Granola’s API rate limits.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Read notes, summaries, transcripts, folders and spaces, and search notes or transcripts. Webhooks, audit logs, legal holds and account management are not forwarded.

notices.title: Access
notices.body: Results follow the key’s scopes and workspace controls. An empty list passes the key check. Only notes with a generated summary are returned. Transcript access may be disabled by an administrator; a successful check does not verify that permission.
